sources.title: GPT-2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GPT-2 is a scaled up version of GPT, a causal transformer language model, with 10x more parameters and training data. The model was pretrained on a 40GB dataset to predict the next word in a sequence based on all the previous words. This approach enabled the model to perform many downstream tasks in a zero-shot setting. The blog post released by OpenAI can be found here.

sources.snippet: A causal investigation into how Large Language Models encode and utilize Part-of-Speech information. This repository implements Linear Probing, Causal Activation Patching, and Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) feature decomposition to map the "Syntax Circuit" of GPT-2 Small. - ZiadiSafouene/GPT2_MI

sources.snippet: Collated activation datasets This document lists the collated activation datasets that are compatible with the Transformer Debugger. These datasets contain some top-activating examples for each MLP neuron, attention head, and autoencoder latent, as well as the corresponding activations for each token (or token pair) in the example.
